## FAQ

Q: What is the cheapest Himalayan trek on Uncharted Travel?
A: The Kheerganga Trek at ₹999 per person (2 Days, Easy, Parvati Valley, Himachal).

Q: What is the most affordable multi-day trek?
A: The Kareri Lake Trek at ₹1,500 per person for a 2-day Easy trek from Dharamshala.

Q: Which treks are best for beginners?
A: Kheerganga Trek (₹999), Kareri Lake Trek (₹1,500), and Buni Buni Pass Trek (₹2,499) are all rated Easy and suitable for first-time trekkers.

Q: Which treks are Hard difficulty?
A: Rupin Pass Trek (7 Days, ₹15,500, starts from Shimla) and Baraadsar Lake Trek (7 Days suggested, ₹20,999/person, Uttarkashi / Himachal border).

Q: How do I book a trek?
A: Visit the trek page on unchartedtravel.in, choose a local guide or operator, and submit an enquiry. There is no booking fee — you connect directly with the guide.

Q: Does Uncharted Travel have guides in Uttarakhand?
A: Yes. Kapil Rawat and Kailash Rawat are based in the Garhwal Himalayas (Sankri area) and lead Kedarkantha, Har Ki Dun, Rupin Pass, and Baraadsar Lake treks.

Q: Does Uncharted Travel have guides in Himachal Pradesh?
A: Yes. Pritam Negi leads treks in Parvati Valley including Sar Pass, Kheerganga, Buni Buni Pass, Dev Roopa, and Hampta Pass. Aatish leads the Kareri Lake Trek from Dharamshala.

Q: What is the highest altitude trek?
A: Rupin Pass Trek reaches 15,250 ft (the pass elevation). Baraadsar Lake sits at approximately 14,108 ft.

Q: What is the best time for Hampta Pass Trek?
A: Mid June to October (from trek data).
